keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Searches to check, one per line, e.g. best crm for small business, "hubspot alternatives", how to choose running shoes.

brands.title: Brands to look for
brands.description: Your brand and competitors, e.g. HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive. Each row says whether the AI Overview mentions them, how often, in what order, and whether their site is cited.

domains.title: Your domains
domains.description: Sites to look for among the AI Overview citations and the organic top 10, e.g. hubspot.com.

includeOrganic.title: Include organic top 10
includeOrganic.description: Organic result titles and domains with positions.

retryUnavailable.title: Retry when Google cannot generate the overview
retryUnavailable.description: Google sometimes replies "Can't generate an AI overview right now". Retry those keywords once.

trackChanges.title: Track changes between runs
trackChanges.description: Remember each keyword's last result and report brands and cited domains gained or lost. History lives in your named key-value store ai-overview-tracker-history.

country.title: Google country
country.description: Two-letter country code (gl), e.g. us, gb, ca, au, in.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language (hl), e.g. en, de, fr, es.
